recommendation: Keep this core clarification. Future changes to the extension definitions themselves should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions; any decision to remove the historical core landing page entirely should be handled separately by the responsible work group or editors.
issue_request: FHIR-13609 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked the core FHIR specification to formally define the SMART on FHIR extensions used on CapabilityStatement.
initial_application: Jira records application in an SVN revision. Git history shows fc9f4585b4 added the smart-app-launch profile entry, introduction page, and spreadsheet definitions for the capabilities and oauth-uris CapabilityStatement.rest.security extensions; R4 published those definitions from core.
additional_context: Later R5 history removed the SMART extension rows from the core spreadsheet while leaving the smart-app-launch profile page active. The current FHIR Extensions Pack owns the formal StructureDefinition sources for http://fhir-registry.smarthealthit.org/StructureDefinition/capabilities and http://fhir-registry.smarthealthit.org/StructureDefinition/oauth-uris, and the current core CI page had stale text followed by an empty Content section.
reconciliation: Updated source/profiles/smart-app-launch-introduction.xml to direct readers to the FHIR Core Extensions Registry pages for capabilities and oauth-uris and to the SMART App Launch IG for the launch specification.
source_changes: source/profiles/smart-app-launch-introduction.xml: replaced stale wording that said the core profile provides formal definitions with links to the current FHIR Core Extensions Registry definitions for capabilities and oauth-uris.
